test_title: SSC CPO 2024 Official Paper-I (Held On: 29 Jun, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Two statements are given, followed by three conclusions numbered I, II and III. Assuming the statements to be true, even if they seem to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

All scanners are printers.

Some scanners are copiers.

**Conclusions:**

I. Some printers are copiers.

II. No copier is a printer.

III. Some printers are scanners.

options.text: Only conclusions I and II follow
Only conclusions I and III follow
Only conclusions II and III follow

solution:
The least possible Venn diagram for the given statements is as shown below :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/23466de56834ed2c5ec16d202acb7af2b8ca687853215b584bec7a3c3d8baa16.png] 

Conclusions:

I. Some printers are copiers → Follow (As all scanners are printers and some scanners are copiers. As whole scanners comes in printers and has some part common with copiers, therefore it is true)

II. No copier is a printer → Does not follow (As all scanners are printers and some scanners are copiers. As no direct relation is given between printers and copiers, therefore it is false.)

III. Some printers are scanners → Follow (As all scanners are printers. As whole scanners comes in printers, therefore it is true)

∴ Here, Only conclusions I and III follow.​

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 3"
